steps.code:
# Get all songs in library and all liked songs
access_token = login_result['access_token']

def get_all_pages(api_func, access_token, **kwargs):
    all_items = []
    page_index = 0
    page_limit = 20
    while True:
        page = api_func(access_token=access_token, page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit, **kwargs)
        if isinstance(page, dict) and 'message' in page:
            # error
            print("Error:", page)
            break
        all_items.extend(page)
        if len(page) < page_limit:
            break
        page_index += 1
    return all_items

# Get all songs in library
library_songs = get_all_pages(apis.spotify.show_song_library, access_token)
print("Library songs count:", len(library_songs))

# Get all liked songs
liked_songs = get_all_pages(apis.spotify.show_liked_songs, access_token)
print("Liked songs count:", len(liked_songs))

# Get all albums in library
library_albums = get_all_pages(apis.spotify.show_album_library, access_token)
print("Library albums count:", len(library_albums))

# Get all liked albums
liked_albums = get_all_pages(apis.spotify.show_liked_albums, access_token)
print("Liked albums count:", len(liked_albums))
